description:
Images on /credits whose agency field (CMSA, SpaceIL, USAF, UAESA, CSA/NASA) identifies a real space agency or operator are grouped under 'Wikimedia Commons contributors' instead of the agency's own section, because agencyToSourceId() in credits-grouping.ts lacks case arms for those strings AND the only file the prior attempt touched was credits-grouping.ts, missing three co-dependent files

Expected: Each image on /credits appears under the section corresponding to its producing agency. The upstream publisher (agency field) wins over the retrieval conduit (source_type field) per provenanceSourceId()'s editorial rule.

Acceptance criteria:
- agency=USAF (20 entries) routes to us-space-force via agencyToSourceId [repo-data: static/data/image-provenance.json has agency='USAF' for 20 entries. static/data/source-logos.json id='us-space-force' exists and covers US military space operations.]
- agency=UAESA (12 entries) and agency='UAESA / NASA' routes to uaesa via agencyToSourceId — current code only matches 'mbrsc' or 'uae space agency' but not the literal 'uaesa' string [repo-data: static/data/image-provenance.json has agency='UAESA' (12 entries). static/data/source-logos.json id='uaesa' exists. agencyToSourceId checks for 'mbrsc'/'uae space agency' but not 'uaesa'.]
- agency=CMSA (135 entries) routes to cnsa via agencyToSourceId [repo-data: static/data/image-provenance.json has agency='CMSA' (135 entries). static/data/source-logos.json id='cnsa' exists as the canonical China bucket.]
- agency='CSA / NASA' (2 entries) routes to csa via agencyToSourceId — CSA is the primary (first) token [repo-data: static/data/image-provenance.json has agency='CSA / NASA' (2 entries). static/data/source-logos.json id='csa' exists.]
- agency=SpaceIL (11 entries) routes to a spaceil source-id — requires a matching source-logos entry in static/data/source-logos.json, otherwise groupBySource's fallback (byId.get(id) ?? byId.get('wikimedia-commons')) silently re-buckets to Commons [reporter: Original report: 'space agencies show up under Wikimedia Commons instead of where they belong.' static/data/image-provenance.json has agency='SpaceIL' (11 entries). static/data/source-logos.json has no id='spaceil' entry — maintainer must decide: add a logo entry, a placeholder entry, or route to an existing section.]
- scripts/validate-credits-bundling.ts mirrors agencyToSourceId and must receive the same case arms — otherwise validate-data fails [spec: scripts/validate-data-runner.ts line 65-67 calls validate-credits-bundling.ts as part of npm run validate-data.]
- src/lib/credits-grouping.test.ts must have test cases for CMSA→cnsa, USAF→us-space-force, UAESA→uaesa, CSA→csa, and SpaceIL→spaceil [code-invariant: The existing test file tests other agency mappings; missing coverage for these five is a gap the prior attempt perpetuated.]

Domain facts:
- CMSA = China Manned Space Agency (Tiangong/Shenzhou). CNSA is parent. Existing convention: fold into CNSA section.
- USAF = United States Air Force (legacy military space, pre-USSF). Route to us-space-force section.
- UAESA = UAE Space Agency. source-logos id='uaesa' already exists.
- CSA = Canadian Space Agency. source-logos id='csa' already exists.
- SpaceIL = Israeli non-profit (Beresheet). No source-logos entry yet — maintainer must decide: new 'spaceil' entry with kind='space-agency' (with or without a logo asset).

Target: src/lib/credits-grouping.ts — agencyToSourceId
Do NOT change DO NOT touch credits-grouping.ts alone — the prior attempt touched ONLY this file and FAILed. The fix must touch 4 files simultaneously: 1) credits-grouping.ts (add case arms for cmsa, spaceil, usaef, uaesa, csa), 2) credits-grouping.test.ts (add test cases), 3) static/data/source-logos.json (add spaceil entry — maintainer decides shape), 4) scripts/validate-credits-bundling.ts (mirror the same arms in its independent copy of agencyToSourceId, otherwise validate-data-runner fails preflight). Without all 4 files, the result is the same FAIL: silent re-bucketing to Commons via groupBySource's fallback or a validator rejection. — it is not the owner of this symptom.
